title: Technical product owner
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical product owner em esteio. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:
Confira a vaga para Oracle cloud finance functional consultant em taubaté. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo  Experiência no setor de saúde é desejável, com bom entendimento de sistemas de saúde, operações clínicas, etc.  Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de forte experiência trabalhando com Oracle Cloud Financials – módulos GL, FAH, EDMCS e AR.  Experiência em projetos de suporte e melhorias (enhancements).  Experiência em desenho e implementação de soluções de sistemas para processos financeiros principais, especialmente nas áreas de  Records to Report (R2 R) e  Order to Cash (O2 C) .   Capacidade de liderar de forma independente o desenho e a transformação da estrutura empresarial, como mapeamento de COA (plano de contas), razão (ledger) e estrutura de unidades de negócio (BU) para empresas complexas. Forte experiência na configuração do Oracle Cloud GL e Accounting Hub para mapeamento de plano de contas (COA), incluindo o desenho de interfaces complexas com sistemas externos.  Experiência na criação de relatórios complexos utilizando Smart View, FRS, BI Publisher e OTBI.  Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle Paa S.  Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.  Responsável por gerenciar o desenho e a entrega ponta a ponta de objetos RICE de alto volume (Interfaces, Conversões, Extensões e Relatórios).  O profissional deve ter fortes habilidades de comunicação para interagir com diversos stakeholders e experiência em todas as fases do projeto: planejamento, levantamento de requisitos, análise de gaps, design, configuração, testes e treinamento, implantação e suporte.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Nova oportunidade para Marketing ai agent builder em rio claro. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé
description:
Nova oportunidade para Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé em rio grande do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você, jovem que está iniciando no mercado de trabalho: Já pensou em construir uma carreira dentro de um dos setores que mais cresce no Brasil? Somos o  Grupo Caburé  , unimos a tradição dos seguros com a inovação da tecnologia. Nascemos com um propósito simples, porém poderoso: proteger pessoas.  Com  mais de 62 anos de história  , nossa essência está enraizada na confiança, na excelência e na capacidade de transformar vidas por meio de soluções acessíveis, inteligentes e humanas.  Atualmente, protegemos  mais de 2 milhões de brasileiros  , atingindo a marca de 28 bilhões de capitais segurados  , e a confiança deles segue sendo nosso maior patrimônio.  O Programa de Formação de Especialistas em Seguro de Vida da Caburé  foi criado para dar oportunidade de formação a novos entrantes no mercado de seguros, para quem tem ambição de crescer financeira e profissionalmente, ingressando em  um dos setores de maior remuneração do mercado financeiro.   SOBRE A VAGA:   A função é voltada para vendas consultivas, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções personalizadas de proteção financeira. O profissional atuará com prospecção ativa, reuniões com clientes, planejamento financeiro e gestão da própria carteira. Aqui você vai aprender a fazer vendas de forma consultiva na linha de frente do mercado financeiro, onde um talento comercial tem o ambiente ideal para crescer de forma meritocrática.  O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ:   • Sonho grande  • Perfil comercial  • Constante busca por evolução e aprendizado  • Não precisa ter experiência no setor. Precisa ter vontade de aprender e determinação para vender.  O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:   • Prospecção ativa  • Reuniões online e presencial com clientes  • Planejamento financeiro personalizado para seus clientes, com foco em seguro de vida  • Gestão de CRM com foco em resultado  • Construção e manutenção da sua carteira de clientes  BENEFÍ CIOS:   Para você chegar nos seus objetivos, pode esperar da gente:  • Comissionamento de até 300% por venda.  • Comissão recorrente, enquanto seu cliente estiver pagando.  • Garantia de R$ 3.000 mensais, no formato de linha d'água  • Ambiente e nicho de vendas de alta conversão;  • Plano de carreira definido: você começa como júnior e pode se tornar líder da própria equipe.  • Formação completa em vendas consultivas e mercado de seguros com base na nossa expertise de mercado de mais de 62 anos. title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Platform engineer / devops engineer em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)   Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions   Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)   Work Hours:  EST   Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)   Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.   You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .   What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)  Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member

title: English teacher
description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher em pindamonhangaba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Empresa está contratando Risk management officer em valinhos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing ai agent builder em londrina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior voip engineer em santa cruz do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing ai agent builder em caraguatatuba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em joinville. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  EST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.  You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .  What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)  Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member

Empresa está contratando Vendedor em taubaté. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

VAGA: VENDEDOR(A) PRESENCIAL – SAVIORA Existe um tipo de vendedor que não aceita ganhar pouco.  Que já trabalhou com meta alta… e sabe o que é bater ou ficar pra trás.  Se você é esse tipo de pessoa, continua lendo.  A Saviora é uma marca de dermocosméticos que está em crescimento acelerado no Brasil, com foco em  performance, experiência e resultado real.  Aqui você não vai vender produto difícil.  Você vai trabalhar com:  Leads quentes  Clientes recorrentes  Carrinhos abandonados  Base ativa pronta pra conversão    Ou seja:  estrutura pronta pra você vender todos os dias.   Remuneração  Salário fixo:  R$ 2.200 + 10% total das vendas mensais    Comissão agressiva por performance  Premiações semanais (dinheiro + incentivos)   Premiações incluem:  Dinheiro extra  Perfumes  Bolsas  Vouchers  Benefícios exclusivos    Aqui, quem performa bem  ganha muito acima da média.   Modelo de trabalho  Presencial  Horário: 09h às 18h (comercial) Estrutura completa fornecida pela empresa    O que você vai encontrar aqui  Ambiente dinâmico e acelerado  Metas reais (e alcançáveis pra quem sabe vender) Time competitivo e colaborativo  Estrutura digital que facilita o fechamento    Você não vai ficar “caçando cliente frio”.  Você vai  fechar vendas.   Quem estamos buscando  Não é pra iniciante.  Buscamos vendedores(as) que:  Já trabalharam com metas agressivas  Sabem lidar com pressão e resultado  Têm experiência comprovada em vendas  Conseguem se comunicar bem (texto e voz) São rápidos, proativos e focados em dinheiro    Diferencial:  Experiência com vendas digitais / Whats App  Histórico de alta performance    Como participar  Envie:  Seu nome  Sua experiência com vendas  Um vídeo curto (1 minuto) se apresentando e contando sua maior venda ou resultado     A maioria das pessoas procura emprego.  Algumas escolhem o ambiente certo e crescem.  A decisão é sua.

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em taubaté. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Platform engineer / devops engineer em vinhedo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:12+ months with extensions Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineerto join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a"boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables100–150 engineersto ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role inday-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improveself-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist withservice instrumentationacross logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate inon-call rotationand support incident response Optimize infrastructure forcost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)Must-Have Requirements 6+ yearsin Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience(IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory)for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding ofobservability concepts(metrics, logs, tracing)Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supportinglarge engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity withsecurity in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background inmid-size, modern engineering organizations What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

title: Coordenador(a) de produto | estilista
description:
Empresa está contratando Coordenador(a) de produto | estilista em apucarana. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

VAGA: DESIGNER / ESTILISTA COM PERFIL DE LIDERANÇA (Coordenadora de Desenvolvimento de Produto) Local: Apucarana/PR (com possibilidade de mudança para Maringá/PR) Estamos em busca de uma profissional da área de moda (designer ou estilista) que una criatividade, organização e capacidade de liderança para atuar no desenvolvimento de produto. Somos uma empresa com mais de 27 anos de atuação no desenvolvimento de peças e bordados para grandes marcas do Brasil, com forte presença na indústria e foco em inovação, qualidade e diferenciação. RESPONSABILIDADES: - Coordenação do setor de desenvolvimento de produto - Acompanhamento da criação até a peça final - Organização de fichas técnicas e fluxo de desenvolvimento - Gestão e direcionamento da equipe de criação - Controle de prazos, metas e entregas - Interface com produção e acabamento - Apoio no desenvolvimento de coleções - Atuação prática no desenvolvimento das peças, incluindo apoio em desenhos, ajustes e execução quando necessário REQUISITOS: - Formação ou experiência em Moda (Design de Moda, Estilismo ou áreas correlatas) - Experiência com desenvolvimento de produto - Vivência com liderança ou coordenação de equipe - Perfil organizado, proativo e resolutivo - Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos - Boa comunicação e postura profissional - Perfil hands-on (disposta a atuar de forma prática no desenvolvimento, quando necessário) DIFERENCIAIS: - Experiência em confecção ou indústria de moda - Conhecimento em bordados, texturas ou técnicas diferenciadas - Experiência com marcas autorais ou desenvolvimento de coleção OFERECEMOS: - Contratação CLT - Salário compatível com o mercado - Convenio farmacia - Seguro de vida - Ambiente estruturado, com histórico sólido e oportunidade de crescimento Envio de currículo: email   watzap

title: Analista financeiro
description:

Analista Financeiro(a) - Júnior, Pleno ou Sênior  1. Gestão de Contratos de Locação e Despesas:   * Controle de Despesas do Imóvel:  Monitorar despesas recorrentes relacionadas ao imóvel, como IPTU, condomínio, fundo de reserva, e custos com água e energia (CASAN, CELESC). Assegurar que todas as cobranças estejam lançadas de maneira correta e transparente para as partes.  * Emissão de Boletos de Aluguel:  Garantir que os boletos de aluguel sejam gerados e enviados com antecedência, facilitando o pagamento por parte dos locatários e minimizando atrasos.  * Repasses para Proprietários:  Processar e assegurar o envio correto dos repasses de aluguéis aos proprietários dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, conciliando valores recebidos com os contratos vigentes.  * Monitoramento de Reembolsos:  Monitorar reembolsos e ressarcimentos relacionados às despesas dos contratos de locação, garantindo precisão no fluxo de cobranças.  2. Rescisão e Finalização de Contratos:   * Cobrança de Rescisões:  Acompanhar todo o processo de rescisão contratual, desde a geração de boletos de rescisão até o acompanhamento do pagamento, devolução de caução e saldo de despesas finais e comunicação com proprietários e locatários. Garantir que todos os encargos e devoluções estejam corretos e em conformidade com o contrato.  3. Cobrança de Aluguéis e Gestão de Inadimplência:   * Monitoramento e Cobrança Proativa: Acompanhar de perto os aluguéis em atraso, manter contato direto com locatários e fiadores para regularização dos pagamentos e criar estratégias para reduzir a inadimplência.  * Gestão de Ações Jurídicas: Auxiliar a liderança nos casos jurídicos, encaminhar casos de inadimplência para o departamento garantindo que toda a documentação esteja organizada e atualizada. Manter o proprietário informado sobre o andamento do processo e os próximos passos.  * Relatórios de Inadimplência: Preencher os relatórios mensais sobre o status das inadimplências e taxas de recuperação.  4. Operação com Seguradoras e Garantias:   * Sinistros e Acionamento de Garantias: Quando necessário, acionar seguradoras ou garantidoras para abrir sinistros e acompanhar todo o processo de indenização organizando toda a documentação e garantindo que o fluxo seja ágil e transparente.  5. Gestão de Contas a Pagar:   * Controle e Organização de Despesas: Gerenciar as contas a pagar da imobiliária, incluindo repasses de aluguel, pagamentos a fornecedores, prestadores de serviços, folha de pagamento e despesas administrativas. Manter controle rigoroso sobre os vencimentos e provisões de caixa monitorando constantemente o fluxo de caixa, acompanhando as previsões de pagamento para garantir que a imobiliária tenha os recursos financeiros necessários para suas obrigações.  6. Contas a Receber e Faturamento:   * Controle de Recebíveis: Monitorar todas as entradas financeiras da empresa, como aluguéis, taxas administrativas e outros serviços prestados. Garantir que os pagamentos sejam realizados conforme os prazos estipulados e que qualquer discrepância seja resolvida de forma rápida.  * Auditoria de Recebíveis: Realizar auditorias periódicas das contas a receber para garantir a precisão dos lançamentos e identificar possíveis discrepâncias ou áreas que precisam de ajustes.  * Relatórios de Contas a Receber: Preparar relatórios detalhados de contas a receber, inadimplência, histórico de recebimentos e tendências de pagamento, fornecendo insights para a equipe de gestão sobre a saúde financeira da imobiliária.  * Emissão de Notas Fiscais: Responsável pela emissão de notas fiscais referentes aos contratos de locação e outros serviços prestados pela imobiliária, mantendo o registro fiscal atualizado e garantindo a conformidade com as obrigações fiscais.  7. Relatórios Financeiros e Análise de Dados:   * Conciliação Bancária: Garantir que todas as transações financeiras estejam devidamente registradas e reconciliadas com os extratos bancários, assegurando a precisão dos dados e que estejam devidamente lançados no sistema, para o devido controle dos contratos de locação e outros serviços.  * Previsão e Planejamento Financeiro: Trabalhar com a equipe de gestão para criar previsões financeiras, identificando tendências de despesas e receitas para apoiar o planejamento estratégico da empresa.  Requisitos:   * Experiência no setor imobiliário, preferencialmente em gestão financeira;  * Conhecimento em Excel;  * Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades com prazos apertados;  * Excelente comunicação interpessoal para lidar com clientes e gestão;  * Visão estratégica e habilidade analítica para interpretar dados financeiros.  Será um diferencial se você tiver:   * Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;  * Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas Google e sistemas de ERP financeiros.  A contratação e  remuneração  será realizada conforme o seu nível de experiência para a função.

title: Analista de pcp
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de pcp em são bernardo do campo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a empresa  Prazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos.  Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM.  Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas:  QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃ O  Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos.  Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos.  A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família.  Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal.  Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher.  A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil.  Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos.  Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena.  Responsabilidades Planejar, programar e controlar a produção, garantindo o atendimento da demanda com eficiência  Elaborar e acompanhar o forecast de produção junto ao comercialo (PMP) Gerenciar níveis de estoque de matérias-primas e produtos acabados  Analisar capacidade produtiva e propor melhorias de fluxo  Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (OTIF, giro de estoque, lead time, etc.) Atuar em conjunto com compras, logística e produção para alinhamento de demandas  Identificar gargalos e propor soluções para otimização de processos   Requisitos Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas  Experiência sólida em PCP, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos ou bens de consumo  Conhecimento no sistemas ERP TOTVS Protheus  Excel avançado (desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas) Experiência com controle de estoque e planejamento de demanda  Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de comunicação   ⭐ Diferenciais Experiência no segmento de alimentos saudáveis ou perecíveis  Vivência em ambientes com alta variabilidade de demanda   Nível da vaga  Pleno ou Sênior (de acordo com experiência e senioridade do candidato) Benefícios (Preencher conforme política da empresa) Vale alimentação/refeição  Vale transporte  Convênio Farmácia  PLR  (Outros benefícios)  Por que trabalhar com a gente? Aqui você fará parte de uma empresa em crescimento, com propósito claro de promover saúde através da alimentação, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em eldorado do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!
