title: Investment banking intern
description:
Confira a vaga para Investment banking intern em boituva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps)  Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)  Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are  hungry, quick learners, and committed  to excelling in a fast-paced environment.  How to Apply:   Get your application in now!  If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.  This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em ponta grossa. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em itapevi. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Commercial lead — brazil

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil. title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em criciúma. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em ivoti. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst - supply chain em esteio. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em jaraguá do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em araraquara. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em guaramirim. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em jaraguá do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. description:

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program   Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.  We are actively  screening thousands of top students globally  to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in  partnership with leading boutique investment banks  in key markets, including  the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.   Only two students are selected per quarter  for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.  What You'll Gain:    Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2):  The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:  3-Statement Financial Modeling  Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis  Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions  Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques  Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies  Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10):  Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:   Pitch Book Development  Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling  Sourcing & Due Diligence  Industry and Company Research  And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.  Mentorship & Feedback:  Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.    This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.  Who We're Looking For:   This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students  (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em francisco beltrão. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.
